_comment: Claude Code provider profiles for scripts/claude-code/switch-claude-code.ps1. No secrets live here — keys come from -Key, an environment variable, or scripts/claude-code/keys.local.json (git-ignored). Verified endpoints researched 2026-10-19.

shellshock.label: ShellShock local free-model gateway
shellshock.notes: Free models only (Kiro, OpenCode Free, OpenRouter free models, NVIDIA NIM, Groq, Cloudflare Workers AI, Ollama). Start ShellShock first: cd ShellShock && npm run launch. Create a key in the dashboard (Endpoint & Key). Models appear as shellshock/<model> or cc/<model>.

radox.label: Radox AI (free Claude / GPT / Kimi / Mythos promo)
radox.notes: From the promo screenshot: sign up at radoxai.com, create an API key, Base URL radoxai.com/v1. Third-party aggregator — free offers can end anytime and the Anthropic surface may differ; if Claude Code returns 404 on /v1/messages, route it through ShellShock as a custom endpoint instead (see README).

beatapi.label: BeatAPI (Free GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1, JEV 1.13)
beatapi.notes: From the screenshot promo: BeatAPI (api.beatapi.io/v1) provides free community endpoints for GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1, and JEV 1.13. If Claude Code returns 404 on /v1/messages, proxy it through ShellShock as a custom OpenAI endpoint (see README).

deepseek.label: DeepSeek official (Anthropic-compatible endpoint)
deepseek.notes: Official DeepSeek Claude Code integration (api-docs.deepseek.com). Very low cost per token. Update model ids if DeepSeek renames them — override with -Model.

zai.label: Z.AI GLM coding plan
zai.notes: Z.AI explicitly supports Claude Code over the Anthropic-native endpoint. Keep the route /api/anthropic — do NOT use /api/paas/v4 (that bills the pay-as-you-go balance instead of the coding plan).

kimi.label: Kimi / Moonshot (pay-as-you-go API keys)
kimi.notes: Works with standard Moonshot platform keys on the Anthropic endpoint. Coding-plan keys (api.kimi.com/coding/v1) are OpenAI-only — for those, use the ShellShock profile and add Kimi there as a custom endpoint. Model id may change; override with -Model.

anthropic.label: Official Anthropic (subscription or console key)
anthropic.notes: Clears every ANTHROPIC_* base-url/token/model override that this switcher manages, returning Claude Code to its stock behaviour.
